name: veilio-guard
description: Keeps your real identifiers and secrets away from the model: every file, command output and prompt reaches Claude with placeholders, and edits are restored before they land.

rawOnly.title: Raw-only paths (optional)
rawOnly.description: Extra glob patterns of files Claude must never read, on top of the built-in list (.env, keys, .veilio). Leave empty to use the built-in list only.

mcpRestore.title: MCP servers that get real names (optional)
mcpRestore.description: MCP servers whose tool arguments are restored to real identifiers before the call. Leave empty to send them placeholders.
